title: How Onions ACTUALLY Make You Cry (And How to Stop Them)
speaker: SciShow
zh: 【SciShow】洋蔥究竟是如何讓你哭泣的（以及如何阻止它們）（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Onions. We love to hate them.
cues.en: Onions. We love to hate them.
cues.zh: 洋蔥。我們對他們又愛又恨。

cues.text: Or rather, our eyes hate that we love them so much.
cues.en: Or rather, our eyes hate that we love them so much.
cues.zh: 或者更確切地說，我們的眼睛討厭我們如此愛它們。

cues.text: They are one of the oldest recorded vegetables in continuous use, with records dating back 4,000 years,
cues.en: They are one of the oldest recorded vegetables in continuous use, with records dating back 4,000 years,
cues.zh: 它們是有記錄的最古老的連續使用蔬菜之一，有記錄可以追溯到 4000 年前，

cues.text: and they’ve made their way into pretty much every culinary tradition in the world.
cues.en: and they’ve made their way into pretty much every culinary tradition in the world.
cues.zh: 它們已經滲透到世界上幾乎所有的烹飪傳統中。

cues.text: As amazing as they are, they’ve got one really annoying flaw: all of the crying.
cues.en: As amazing as they are, they’ve got one really annoying flaw: all of the crying.
cues.zh: 儘管它們很神奇，但它們有一個非常煩人的缺陷：總是哭。

cues.text: Every time you cut into one, you can’t help but well up like you’re watching a sad dog movie.
cues.en: Every time you cut into one, you can’t help but well up like you’re watching a sad dog movie.
cues.zh: 每次切入一個，你都會情不自禁地湧上心頭，就像在看一部悲傷的狗電影一樣。

cues.text: We actually know quite a lot about what’s happening at the chemical and biological levels to make this reaction happen.
cues.en: We actually know quite a lot about what’s happening at the chemical and biological levels to make this reaction happen.
cues.zh: 事實上，我們對化學和生物層面上發生的反應瞭解很多。

cues.text: But a study published in October 2025 looks at the onion-crying problem
cues.en: But a study published in October 2025 looks at the onion-crying problem
cues.zh: 但 2025 年 10 月發表的一項研究著眼於洋蔥哭泣問題

cues.text: from a new perspective: physics.
cues.en: from a new perspective: physics.
cues.zh: 從一個新的角度：物理學。

cues.text: They examined the droplets flung out of an onion being cut in various ways with a precisely-tuned onion guillotine.
cues.en: They examined the droplets flung out of an onion being cut in various ways with a precisely-tuned onion guillotine.
cues.zh: 他們用精確調節的洋蔥斷頭臺檢查了以各種方式切割的洋蔥中噴出的液滴。

cues.text: And the results show us there is still more to learn about how onions make us cry.
cues.en: And the results show us there is still more to learn about how onions make us cry.
cues.zh: 結果表明，關於洋蔥如何讓我們流淚，我們還有更多需要了解的地方。

cues.text: Now before we dive into the French Revolution of onions, let’s recap the science
cues.en: Now before we dive into the French Revolution of onions, let’s recap the science
cues.zh: 現在，在我們深入探討法國洋蔥革命之前，讓我們先回顧一下科學知識

cues.text: behind the onion’s uncanny ability to bring tears to even the toughest eyes.
cues.en: behind the onion’s uncanny ability to bring tears to even the toughest eyes.
cues.zh: 洋蔥具有神奇的能力，即使是最堅強的眼睛也會流淚。

cues.text: There’s a chemical that gets released when you cut into an onion called syn-propanethial-S-oxide which causes the glands in your eye
cues.en: There’s a chemical that gets released when you cut into an onion called syn-propanethial-S-oxide which causes the glands in your eye
cues.zh: 當你切洋蔥時，會釋放出一種叫做順丙硫醛-S-氧化物的化學物質，它會導致你眼睛裡的腺體

cues.text: that produce tears to work overtime to attempt to flush the irritant of your eyes.
cues.en: that produce tears to work overtime to attempt to flush the irritant of your eyes.
cues.zh: 產生的眼淚會加班，試圖沖掉眼睛的刺激物。

cues.text: The weird thing is, onions don’t contain any propanethial-S-oxide.
cues.en: The weird thing is, onions don’t contain any propanethial-S-oxide.
cues.zh: 奇怪的是，洋蔥不含任何丙硫醛-S-氧化物。

cues.text: Instead, they contain the ingredients for it.
cues.en: Instead, they contain the ingredients for it.
cues.zh: 相反，它們含有它的成分。

cues.text: First, when you cut into the onion, your knife breaks open a lot of cell walls.
cues.en: First, when you cut into the onion, your knife breaks open a lot of cell walls.
cues.zh: 首先，當你切洋蔥時，你的刀會切開很多細胞壁。

cues.text: And this is all the onion needs to introduce the enzyme alliinase to air and produce 1-propenesulfenic acid.
cues.en: And this is all the onion needs to introduce the enzyme alliinase to air and produce 1-propenesulfenic acid.
cues.zh: 這就是洋蔥將蒜氨酸酶引入空氣並產生 1-丙烯次磺酸所需的全部。

cues.text: That chemical then reacts further with another enzyme to make the tear-inducing propanethial-S-oxide.
cues.en: That chemical then reacts further with another enzyme to make the tear-inducing propanethial-S-oxide.
cues.zh: 然後，這種化學物質與另一種酵素進一步反應，生成誘導眼淚的丙硫醛-S-氧化物。

cues.text: Given how long we’ve been tearing up at onions, you might be surprised at how recent some of this science is.
cues.en: Given how long we’ve been tearing up at onions, you might be surprised at how recent some of this science is.
cues.zh: 考慮到我們對洋蔥的痴迷已經有很長時間了，你可能會驚訝於這門科學的一些最新進展。

cues.text: We only discovered that second step, where 1-propenesulfenic acid reacts
cues.en: We only discovered that second step, where 1-propenesulfenic acid reacts
cues.zh: 我們只發現了第二步，1-丙烯次磺酸發生反應

cues.text: to another enzyme to make the actual tear-jerker substance, in 2002.
cues.en: to another enzyme to make the actual tear-jerker substance, in 2002.
cues.zh: 2002 年，科學家開發出另一種酵素來製造真正催人淚下的物質。

cues.text: Which, to me, is like 5 years ago.
cues.en: Which, to me, is like 5 years ago.
cues.zh: 對我來說，這就像五年前一樣。

cues.text: So that’s the chemistry behind the effect.
cues.en: So that’s the chemistry behind the effect.
cues.zh: 這就是效果背後的化學反應。

cues.text: A weird side-note: onions get their sulfur from the soil,
cues.en: A weird side-note: onions get their sulfur from the soil,
cues.zh: 一個奇怪的旁註：洋蔥從土壤中獲取硫，

cues.text: and acid rain contains a lot of sulfur.
cues.en: and acid rain contains a lot of sulfur.
cues.zh: 酸雨中含有大量的硫。

cues.text: So a strange consequence of the success of tackling acid rain in many urban areas is that it might actually make onions milder!
cues.en: So a strange consequence of the success of tackling acid rain in many urban areas is that it might actually make onions milder!
cues.zh: 因此，許多城市地區成功應對酸雨的一個奇怪後果是，它實際上可能使洋蔥變得更溫和！

cues.text: It feels like it was worse when I was a kid.
cues.en: It feels like it was worse when I was a kid.
cues.zh: 感覺小時候更慘。

cues.text: Maybe I’m just stronger now.
cues.en: Maybe I’m just stronger now.
cues.zh: 也許我現在更堅強了。

cues.text: This molecule is also pretty much unstoppable once it gets to your eyes,
cues.en: This molecule is also pretty much unstoppable once it gets to your eyes,
cues.zh: 這種分子一旦進入你的眼睛就幾乎無法阻擋，

cues.text: so the only way to truly avoid tearing up is to prevent it from reaching your eyes in the first place.
cues.en: so the only way to truly avoid tearing up is to prevent it from reaching your eyes in the first place.
cues.zh: 因此，真正避免流淚的唯一方法就是從一開始就防止它到達您的眼睛。

cues.text: So the chemistry and biology are pretty much solved.
cues.en: So the chemistry and biology are pretty much solved.
cues.zh: 這樣化學和生物學就基本解決了。

cues.text: But what hasn’t been addressed yet is the physics.
cues.en: But what hasn’t been addressed yet is the physics.
cues.zh: 但尚未解決的是物理問題。

cues.text: As in, we don’t know exactly how this substance travels to your eyes in order to be able to stop it.
cues.en: As in, we don’t know exactly how this substance travels to your eyes in order to be able to stop it.
cues.zh: 例如，我們不確切知道這種物質如何進入您的眼睛以便能夠阻止它。

cues.text: Enter: the onion guillotine, courtesy of a research group at Cornell University.
cues.en: Enter: the onion guillotine, courtesy of a research group at Cornell University.
cues.zh: 輸入：洋蔥斷頭臺，由康奈爾大學的一個研究小組提供。

cues.text: They also employed high-speed cameras and an electron microscope
cues.en: They also employed high-speed cameras and an electron microscope
cues.zh: 他們還使用了高速攝像機和電子顯微鏡

cues.text: to test which configurations of knife sharpness, angle and speed of cutting,
cues.en: to test which configurations of knife sharpness, angle and speed of cutting,
cues.zh: 測試刀具鋒利度、切割角度和切割速度的配置，

cues.text: and temperature of onion resulted in the worst onion-juice splashes.
cues.en: and temperature of onion resulted in the worst onion-juice splashes.
cues.zh: 洋蔥的溫度導致了最嚴重的洋蔥汁飛濺。

cues.text: They found that the chemical is carried in droplets, released in an initial burst when a blade first punctures the onion’s surface,
cues.en: They found that the chemical is carried in droplets, released in an initial burst when a blade first punctures the onion’s surface,
cues.zh: 他們發現這種化學物質以液滴形式攜帶，當刀片第一次刺穿洋蔥表面時，液滴會在最初的爆發中釋放出來，

cues.text: then more slowly as the blade travels through.
cues.en: then more slowly as the blade travels through.
cues.zh: 然後當刀片穿過時速度會變慢。

cues.text: In their tests, a more blunt blade applied more pressure to the membrane before breaking it, causing a bigger burst of droplets.
cues.en: In their tests, a more blunt blade applied more pressure to the membrane before breaking it, causing a bigger burst of droplets.
cues.zh: 在他們的測試中，更鈍的刀片在打破膜之前對膜施加了更大的壓力，導致更大的液滴爆發。

cues.text: And that reinforces the wisdom that you should always use a sharp knife in the kitchen.
cues.en: And that reinforces the wisdom that you should always use a sharp knife in the kitchen.
cues.zh: 這強化了這樣的智慧：在廚房裡應該始終使用鋒利的刀。

cues.text: Keeping blades sharp also reduces the chance of injuring yourself (which seems a little counterintuitive, but it reduces the amount of pressure
cues.en: Keeping blades sharp also reduces the chance of injuring yourself (which seems a little counterintuitive, but it reduces the amount of pressure
cues.zh: 保持刀片鋒利還可以減少受傷的機會（這似乎有點違反直覺，但它可以減少壓力

cues.text: you need and the chance of the knife slipping).
cues.en: you need and the chance of the knife slipping).
cues.zh: 你需要和刀打滑的機會）。

cues.text: But this is another, brand new reason!
cues.en: But this is another, brand new reason!
cues.zh: 但這是另一個、全新的原因！

cues.text: The Cornell team also found that cutting faster caused more droplets to be released, so a cautious approach
cues.en: The Cornell team also found that cutting faster caused more droplets to be released, so a cautious approach
cues.zh: 康奈爾大學團隊還發現，切割速度越快會導致釋放更多的液滴，因此採取謹慎的方法

cues.text: with a sharp knife might be the best way to minimize tear production.
cues.en: with a sharp knife might be the best way to minimize tear production.
cues.zh: 使用鋒利的刀可能是減少眼淚產生的最佳方法。

cues.text: As for the common “hack” of putting your onions in the fridge to somehow
cues.en: As for the common “hack” of putting your onions in the fridge to somehow
cues.zh: 至於將洋蔥放入冰箱的常見“技巧”

cues.text: limit their ability to hurt your tear ducts’ feelings, the researchers did not find any support for this.
cues.en: limit their ability to hurt your tear ducts’ feelings, the researchers did not find any support for this.
cues.zh: 限制它們傷害你的淚管感覺的能力，研究人員沒有找到任何支援這一點的證據。

cues.text: In fact, chilled onions released more droplets in their experiments.
cues.en: In fact, chilled onions released more droplets in their experiments.
cues.zh: 事實上，冷凍洋蔥在實驗中釋放出更多的液滴。

cues.text: They thought that this might be because the onion tissues get stiffer when cold,
cues.en: They thought that this might be because the onion tissues get stiffer when cold,
cues.zh: 他們認為這可能是因為洋蔥組織在寒冷時會變硬，

cues.text: causing them to absorb more of the knife’s pressure before breaking, then bursting with even more energy.
cues.en: causing them to absorb more of the knife’s pressure before breaking, then bursting with even more energy.
cues.zh: 使它們在斷裂之前吸收更多刀的壓力，然後爆發出更多的能量。

cues.text: There’s another solution running around out there, which is that you should put a damp towel
cues.en: There’s another solution running around out there, which is that you should put a damp towel
cues.zh: 還有另一個解決方案，那就是你應該放一條濕毛巾

cues.text: or bowl of water near where you’re cutting.
cues.en: or bowl of water near where you’re cutting.
cues.zh: 或在你要切割的地方附近放一碗水。

cues.text: Given that the offending chemical is water-soluble, if you could somehow get the onion droplets
cues.en: Given that the offending chemical is water-soluble, if you could somehow get the onion droplets
cues.zh: 鑑於這種令人討厭的化學物質是水溶性的，如果你能以某種方式得到洋蔥滴

cues.text: to hit the water before it hits your eyes, that seems like it could work.
cues.en: to hit the water before it hits your eyes, that seems like it could work.
cues.zh: 在水濺到你的眼睛之前先把它打到水裡，這似乎可行。

cues.text: It wasn’t part of the experiments in this paper, but if I’m allowed to make requests, it might make for a good follow-up!
cues.en: It wasn’t part of the experiments in this paper, but if I’m allowed to make requests, it might make for a good follow-up!
cues.zh: 這不是本文實驗的一部分，但如果允許我提出請求，這可能會成為一個很好的後續行動！

cues.text: Our speculation, though, is that the Cornell’s team’s experiments show the droplets flying upwards,
cues.en: Our speculation, though, is that the Cornell’s team’s experiments show the droplets flying upwards,
cues.zh: 不過，我們的猜測是，康乃爾大學團隊的實驗表明，水滴會向上飛行，

cues.text: so water on the worktop can only work to mop up splashes and bounces,
cues.en: so water on the worktop can only work to mop up splashes and bounces,
cues.zh: 所以工作臺上的水只能用來擦拭濺出的水花和彈跳的水，

cues.text: and wouldn’t be in a position to stop that first attack on your eyeballs.
cues.en: and wouldn’t be in a position to stop that first attack on your eyeballs.
cues.zh: 並且無法阻止對你眼球的第一次攻擊。

cues.text: Outside of just stopping a common kitchen annoyance, this research has implications for food safety in general.
cues.en: Outside of just stopping a common kitchen annoyance, this research has implications for food safety in general.
cues.zh: 除了消除常見的廚房煩惱之外，這項研究還對食品安全產生了整體影響。

cues.text: Droplets sprayed from vegetables don’t only carry tear-inducing chemicals,
cues.en: Droplets sprayed from vegetables don’t only carry tear-inducing chemicals,
cues.zh: 蔬菜噴出的水滴不僅攜帶催淚化學物質，

cues.text: but also potentially foodborne pathogens as well.
cues.en: but also potentially foodborne pathogens as well.
cues.zh: 還有潛在的食源性病原體。

cues.text: So, this research suggests that a sharper knife keeps your kitchen safe in yet another way, by preventing potential pathogens from being spread around.
cues.en: So, this research suggests that a sharper knife keeps your kitchen safe in yet another way, by preventing potential pathogens from being spread around.
cues.zh: 因此，這項研究表明，更鋒利的刀可以透過防止潛在病原體傳播來確保廚房安全。

cues.text: Armed with the knowledge from an onion guillotine and some fancy imaging equipment, we can at least help you out
cues.en: Armed with the knowledge from an onion guillotine and some fancy imaging equipment, we can at least help you out
cues.zh: 憑藉洋蔥斷頭臺和一些精美成像裝置的知識，我們至少可以幫助您

cues.text: if you really can’t stand that stinging feeling in your eyes.
cues.en: if you really can’t stand that stinging feeling in your eyes.
cues.zh: 如果你實在受不了眼睛裡那種刺痛的感覺。

cues.text: The best way to limit the amount of onion droplets spraying into your eyes
cues.en: The best way to limit the amount of onion droplets spraying into your eyes
cues.zh: 限制噴入眼睛的洋蔥液滴量的最佳方法

cues.text: seems to be to keep your knife sharp and to cut slowly.
cues.en: seems to be to keep your knife sharp and to cut slowly.
cues.zh: 似乎是要保持刀鋒利並慢慢地切。

cues.text: Short of investing in goggles, anyway.
cues.en: Short of investing in goggles, anyway.
cues.zh: 無論如何，缺乏對護目鏡的投資。

cues.text: Which I have heard from prep cooks, is something they do.
cues.en: Which I have heard from prep cooks, is something they do.
cues.zh: 我從預備廚師那裡聽說，他們就是這樣做的。

cues.text: And wildly, that strategy might also keep your whole kitchen safer at the same time.
cues.en: And wildly, that strategy might also keep your whole kitchen safer at the same time.
cues.zh: 更瘋狂的是，這種策略也可能同時讓你的整個廚房更安全。
